Blackbook — Normal growth (BA=CA): Familial Tall Stature, XYY Syndrome · Accelerated growth (BA>CA): Obese BMI → Exogenous Obesity; Non-obese BMI → Normal puberty onset: GH Excess, Hyperthyroidism

Disproportionate: Klinefelter’s Syndrome (XXY), Soto’s Syndrome/ Cerebral Gigantism, Marfan’s Syndrome, Homocystinuria, Sex Steroid Deficiency/ Resistance, Acromegaly (Rare in Children)

Proportionate: Beckwith-Wiedemann Syndrome (Normalizing growth after birth), Weaver Syndrome, XYY Syndrome, Neurofibromatosis 1, Hyperthyroidism (Untreated/Severe)

Precocious Puberty (early puberty onset, non-obese BMI, accelerated growth): Adrenal Tumor, Ovarian Tumor, Testotoxicosis, Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia

Constitutional: Constitutional Tall Stature (Early Bloomer)
